_about: Glossary terms owned by batch B5 (deploy, NPU, reference). One file per batch.

multipod.short: A Kubernetes deployment that puts one AFD role per pod. Each vllm serve is gated on a POD environment variable, so with POD unset nothing runs.

hccl.short: Huawei Collective Communication Library, the Ascend NPU collective transport. The CAMP2p connector carries hidden states over HCCL and DP metadata over a smaller Gloo group.

batch-size-factor.short: An Ascend NPU environment variable that multiplies the CAM receive capacity (base 262144 tokens), with native float rounding. Default 1.
batch-size-factor.long: Read in afd_plugin/validation.py:45-54 and afd_plugin/compat/npu/feature_validation.py:245-249. It has no effect on GPU.
